desc: The Wonder Rifle is our answer to a lightweight carbine with just the right amount of upgrades. The Wonder provides a beautiful balance between utility and luxury. It features our ambidextrous rear sling mount, Renegade Rail with patented heat sink barrel nut, DI bolt carrier group with Roller Cam Pin, single stage straight match grade trigger, our new Strike Eagle Ambi Charging Handle, and our new Micro B single port muzzle brake.
